mapper.select: SELECT attr_key AS attrKey, sort_order AS sortOrder, attr_name AS attrName, attr_type AS attrType, default_value AS defaultValue, value_kind AS valueKind, rate_target_attr_key AS rateTargetAttrKey, min_value AS minValue, max_value AS maxValue FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY sort_order, attr_key

SELECT attr_key AS attrKey, sort_order AS sortOrder, attr_name AS attrName, attr_type AS attrType, default_value AS defaultValue, value_kind AS valueKind, rate_target_attr_key AS rateTargetAttrKey, min_value AS minValue, max_value AS maxValue FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND attr_key = #{attrKey}

SELECT attr_key AS attrKey, sort_order AS sortOrder, attr_name AS attrName, attr_type AS attrType, default_value AS defaultValue, value_kind AS valueKind, rate_target_attr_key AS rateTargetAttrKey, min_value AS minValue, max_value AS maxValue FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY sort_order, attr_key
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.attribute_definitions (game_id, attr_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, sort_order, attr_name, attr_type, default_value, value_kind, rate_target_attr_key, min_value, max_value, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{attrKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{sortOrder}, #{attrName}, #{attrType}, #{defaultValue}, #{valueKind}, #{rateTargetAttrKey}, #{minValue}, #{maxValue}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, attr_key) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, attr_name = EXCLUDED.attr_name, attr_type = EXCLUDED.attr_type, default_value = EXCLUDED.default_value, value_kind = EXCLUDED.value_kind, rate_target_attr_key = EXCLUDED.rate_target_attr_key, min_value = EXCLUDED.min_value, max_value = EXCLUDED.max_value, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.attribute_definitions_log (game_id, attr_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, sort_order, attr_name, attr_type, default_value, value_kind, rate_target_attr_key, min_value, max_value) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{attrKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{sortOrder}, #{attrName}, #{attrType}, #{defaultValue}, #{valueKind}, #{rateTargetAttrKey}, #{minValue}, #{maxValue}) ON CONFLICT (game_id, attr_key, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, attr_name = EXCLUDED.attr_name, attr_type = EXCLUDED.attr_type, default_value = EXCLUDED.default_value, value_kind = EXCLUDED.value_kind, rate_target_attr_key = EXCLUDED.rate_target_attr_key, min_value = EXCLUDED.min_value, max_value = EXCLUDED.max_value
